trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Awarded automatically once every other trophy (54 in total: 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze) has been unlocked across the main campaign, side activities, collectibles, and miscellaneous challenges.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story-related objective. Unlocks upon completing the prologue tutorial mission "Gone Fishing". Cannot be missed as it is required to progress into the open world.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story-related objective. Complete all primary narrative missions comprising Chapter 1 of the campaign. Unlocks during the end-of-chapter sequence.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story-related objective. Complete all primary narrative missions comprising Chapter 2 of the campaign. Unlocks automatically during the transition cutscene into Chapter 3.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story-related objective. Complete all narrative story missions belonging to Chapter 3 as the protagonists expand their footprint across Vice City proper.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story-related objective. Finish the culminating storyline missions of Chapter 4. Unlocks after resolving the high-stakes climax before the final stretch.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Main storyline conclusion. Complete the final campaign heist/mission. Unlocks when the end credits begin rolling or in the post-game debriefing.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story-related mission. Complete the early robbery and getaway mission "Breakfast Run". Cannot be missed during main quest progression.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story-related heist. Infiltrate and successfully complete "The Cartel Heist". Focus on completing team objectives and clean vehicle escape.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story-related mission. Complete the story mission "Child's Play". Unlocks immediately upon concluding the final objective cutscene.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story-related mission. Complete the story mission "Headliners". Required for campaign progression through the club and nightlife storyline.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story-related mission. Complete "VCIA Takedown" at Vice City International Airport. Follow the mission checkpoints to secure the target and clear runway airspace.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story-related military/offshore operation. Complete the tactical campaign mission "Operation Savage Glory". Stock high-caliber ammunition and body armor before launching.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% Game Completion under the in-game Statistics menu. Requires finishing all main story missions, designated side strands, activity trials, card decks, stunts, and property acquisitions.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Execute 250 successful stunt maneuvers (ramps, high-speed jumps, two-wheel balances, barrel rolls) across Leonida. Use a tuned sports car or motorcycle on highway overpasses and beach ramps.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate at least once in each distinct leisure activity available in the state of Leonida, including bowling, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade machines, meditation, and street racing.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit Ammu-Nation shooting range facilities and achieve Gold medal tier on all 42 weapon class trials (Pistols, SMGs, Rifles, Shotguns, Heavy, and Precision targets). Prioritize headshots and consecutive accuracy streaks.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Locate all Top Fun drone racing checkpoints spread throughout Leonida. Win 1st place in every designated drone course by mastering tight cornering and boost management.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Compete in and win 20 distinct street, off-road, or water races across the map. Repeated wins on the same track count only once towards the 20 unique victories.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge the local fisherman Cal at his pier/waterway spot. Match line tension prompts and reel in the heaviest catch within the time limit to beat his score.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Interact with any working retro arcade cabinet in a bar, club, or dedicated arcade parlor. Clear all stages or defeat the final boss of the arcade game to finish it.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's side storyline. Progress through his initial encounter missions until his culminating mission appears on the map, then complete its objectives.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's side storyline. Undertake his maritime and coastal tasks across the keys until his finale mission unlocks and is successfully resolved.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's side storyline. Help him resolve his biker and highway disputes through his final narrative strand.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Discover and finish 8 full Strangers & Freaks multi-part mission strands marked by question marks and character icons throughout Leonida.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's side storyline. Follow Randy's logistics and contraband deliveries through to his final story mission.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's side storyline. Advance Tyrone's turf and music promotion missions up to his final confrontation.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Locate all designated meditation retreats and scenic lookout mats positioned across Leonida. Complete a meditation session at each site to record full harmony.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Accept Bret's hunting contract in the swamplands/nature reserves. Track the designated legendary/unique creature with thermal vision or scent masking and deliver the hunt.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Scattered throughout Vice City and rural Leonida are collectible trading cards. Gather all cards required to complete 3 full themed collector sets.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Find and perform the "WAiNK It" interaction at 100 distinct designated hotspot spots across Leonida. Tracked via the in-game statistics counter.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 in-game checklist challenges (combat feats, stunt driving milestones, weapon proficiencies, and survival benchmarks).
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableReason: Requires free-roaming partner companion. If campaign events separate the duo or change partner availability in late game, opportunity can be missed.
trophies.guide: Raise police attention to a 4-star Wanted Level while accompanied by your partner. Evade search radius cones and hide in alleyways or spray shops until heat dissipates.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableReason: Fails if wanted level expires between stores, or if partner companion is unavailable due to story milestones. Must be done in rapid succession.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, hold up 3 convenience or liquor stores in direct succession. Do not allow your Wanted Level to drop or clear between entering stores.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Enter and drive 100 distinct vehicle models (sedans, supercars, trucks, boats, aircraft, industrial haulers, motorbikes) to register them in your vehicle index.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate the Combat Focus special ability during an enemy shootout and eliminate 5 hostile targets before the slow-motion focus gauge runs dry.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Breach the perimeter at Vice City International Airport (VCIA), commandeer an aircraft or execute an illicit high-speed runway escape without clearance.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Acquire a Rhino military tank (via military base heist or 5-star response) and cause havoc or withstand heavy retaliation inside the armored vehicle.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableReason: Alarms or witness alerts immediately void stealth criteria. If store robbery does not reset promptly, requires reloading recent save.
trophies.guide: Infiltrate and rob a high-end jewelry store silently. Disable security cameras, neutralize the clerk before the silent alarm is triggered, smash cases, and slip away.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Drill or blast open 5 major commercial Bank Vaults across Leonida and successfully shake off the ensuing maximum-security police response.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Ambush a security Armored Truck convoy in transit. Block the vehicle, blow open the rear security doors with explosives, collect cash bags, and escape.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover the full map fog-of-war by visiting all 52 geographic districts, suburbs, coastal keys, and nature reserves that make up the state of Leonida.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableReason: Taking over territories or eliminating gang bosses through narrative progression may permanently shut down faction illicit operations before hitting all 9.
trophies.guide: Identify and raid at least one illegal drug/weapons/chop-shop operation belonging to each of the 9 rival criminal syndicates operating in Leonida.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to the Ocean Beach promenade at sunset, visit a rooftop beachfront bar or hotel lounge, order a signature cocktail, and take in the panoramic vista.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal an exotic vehicle from an auto showroom and ram directly through the display glass windows onto the street in classic Vice City tradition.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley establishment, play a full bowling match, and achieve a spare or strike with proper follow-through.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach a high synergy or public notoriety milestone with your partner duo, demonstrating mass appeal across social channels or crowd interactions.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableReason: Branching dialogue decisions and tactical heist choices occur across limited story moments. Tracking up to 500 choices demands consistent engagement.
trophies.guide: Engage with dialogue prompts, NPC interactions, tactical heist approaches, and branching moral decisions until your cumulative choices tally reaches 500.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Triggered upon succeeding on the immediate second attempt of an activity, heist checkpoint, or failed encounter.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Encounter a mysterious extraterrestrial sighting, paranormal anomaly, or bizarre folklore occurrence hidden in the secluded wilderness of Leonida.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Equip a melee weapon (baseball bat, crowbar, or nightstick) while riding a motorcycle or open vehicle, and strike a target as you pass by.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 worth of marked bills acquired from heists and store stickups through your established money-washing business contacts.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative total of $100,000 across Leonida retail storefronts, including clothing boutiques, weapon shops, vehicle mod garages, and dining spots.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties across the map to store your expanding collection of customized getaway cars and exotics.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Locate eligible motor scooters and register 10 different vehicles into the in-game Scooter Bros mobility network app.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (kit starter; Exophase / PSNProfiles listing of 18 November 2026)
